description: Traditional Slavic folk song metadata for MusicBrainz

songs.title: Kalinka
songs.comment: A well-known Russian folk song about a snowball tree (kalina). Often performed with increasing tempo.

songs.title: Katyusha
songs.comment: A Soviet-era folk-style song about a young woman longing for her beloved serving in the military.

songs.title: Polyushko-polye
songs.comment: Also known as 'Meadowlands', a Russian folk-inspired song depicting cavalry riding across the steppe.

songs.title: Oj, jav ta ne jav
songs.comment: A traditional Ukrainian folk song, often performed a cappella, about dreams and longing.

songs.title: Shchedryk
songs.comment: A Ukrainian New Year's carol composed by Mykola Leontovych; known worldwide as 'Carol of the Bells'.

songs.title: Pije kuna rodušku
songs.comment: A traditional Croatian folk song from the Dalmatian region.

songs.title: Aj, luci, luci
songs.comment: A traditional Slovak folk song, commonly sung at social gatherings and weddings.

songs.title: Szła dzieweczka do gajonka
songs.comment: A traditional Polish folk song about a young girl walking to the grove.

songs.title: Ej, od vinograda
songs.comment: A traditional Serbian folk song associated with the vineyard regions of the Balkans.

songs.title: Bielasie jeł i harad
songs.comment: A traditional Belarusian folk song reflecting rural life and landscapes.
